turns.replyText:
Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?Ask MaggieWelcome to Bandolier! I'm here to guide you through our collection of luxury crossbody phone cases, bags, and accessories. To get started, could you tell me what you're looking for in a product? Are you interested in something for everyday use or a special occasion?

Title: What do you recommend?
We've got you. Our Style Quiz is the perfect place to start to find your next luxury phone case and accessory—whether your style is classic, trendy, or edge, we have what you're looking for.

Title: I don't know the order number
No worries. Your order number should be in your Bandolier order confirmation email. If you can't find it, please contact Customer Support using the same email address you used to place your order and they'll be able to assist you.

Title: I don't know the email address used to place the order
I'm sorry to hear that. Your order number should be in your Bandolier order confirmation email.
If you can't find it, please contact Customer Support and they'll be happy to assist you.

Title: Where can I find new arrivals?
Explore our New Arrivals Collection for the latest styles.

Title: Could you help me find my order?

Title: I want to talk to a human
You can talk to a human by contacting us here.

Title: How do I make a return or exchange?
You can start a return or exchange through our easy online return portal. Simply enter your order details and follow the prompts to complete your request. Visit our Return and Exchanges Portal to get started.

Title: Where can I find frequently asked questions?
You can find our Frequently Asked Questions here.
